items.name: ibis Deauville Centre
items.description:
Located in front of the marina and 200 metres from Deauville train station, ibis Deaville Centre is a 10-minute walk from the beach. It includes a wine bar open for dinner and a bar.

The air-conditioned rooms at ibis Deauville centre have free WiFi access, a flat-screen TV and a bathroom fitted with a shower and hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast composed of sweet and savoury dishes such as eggs, fruit salad, yogurts and juices is served every day. Pastries baked on site and fresh French Madeleine cakes are also on offer, as well as a hot beverage and a piece of fruit to take away. Outside of regular breakfast hours guests can also enjoy a lighter option, available from 04:00. After breakfast, you can enjoy a walk on Les Planches de Deauville.

The hotel is situated 1.5 km from the casino and 2 km from the Centre International de Deauville. Guests staying at La Loggia Appart'Hôtel will have access to a range of services such as the lounge bar, the summer seasonal outdoor heated swimming pool in the Hotel Le Trophée, located right across the street.

Buffet breakfast is served every morning at the Hotel Le Trophée.

hostInfo.name: Pierre & Vacances
hostInfo.welcomeMessage: Soak up the charm of Deauville when you stay at Les Embruns! Situated 250 m from the beach and close to the shops, it has a charming half-timbered facade and fully-equipped flats. It's the ideal address for a stay between sea and town!
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Created in 1967 in Avoriaz, Pierre & Vacances has been offering residences in the heart of the most beautiful destinations by the sea, in the mountains and in the countryside for over 55 years. 
A benchmark player in French tourism, with a strong local presence, Pierre & Vacances is committed to local, low-carbon holidays.

The brand's mission is to bring its customers closer to their surroundings, by offering them the best locations, breathtaking views, accommodation and services designed with families in mind, swimming pools in the majority of its residences and teams to help customers discover the destination. Today, with almost 200 residences in France and Spain, Pierre & Vacances welcomes over 2 million holidaymakers every year.

Our mission is to make you prefer holidays closer to home. We are committed to reducing our carbon emissions linked to the energy consumption of our residences and have put in place an initial energy sobriety plan to be launched in 2022. 

"At Pierre & Vacances, we are convinced that settling in the heart of the most beautiful destinations makes our customers' holidays a success".
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
In Normandy, just 2 hours from Paris, Deauville is one of the most fashionable seaside resorts on the Côte Fleurie. The Pays d'Auge, a region of hedged farmland and stud farms, gives pride of place to horses and equestrian sports.

- Around 25 km from the residence, discover the 8,500-hectare Seine Estuary Nature Reserve. It offers a remarkable diversity of landscapes and is home to over 250 species of birds.
- In Deauville, you'll fall under the spell of its half-timbered architecture, its endless beaches and its "Planches", and you can also enjoy its luxury boutiques and its sumptuous casino, which also houses a theatre.
- In the Pays d'Auge, a region of stud farms, horse racing, polo tournaments and the sale of yearlings make Deauville famous.
hostInfo.familyTips: This residence is ideal for families with babies, and to keep your children happy, there's a play area waiting for them in the residence! Fun for all the family.
